baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dispatch pair at words 3-4, the carried guidance and true din at words 5-7, and the purpose clause at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sender releases a messenger carrying directional guidance and firm truth; the purpose clause moves that carried order from dispatch into public visibility across the whole field, while hostile aversion cannot veto the motion.

activation_trace.role: Being sent forth supplies the outbound motion, with the messenger as the released carrier.
Gentle guidance toward a way supplies directed rather than merely transported content.
Firm truth against falsehood gives the carried din resistance to hostile relabeling.
Coming out into view supplies the purpose and endpoint of the dispatch.
Totality and completeness extend the manifestation across the entire din-field.
Aversion supplies receptor-side resistance without becoming a causal veto.

changed_reading.before: A messenger is sent so that one religion will defeat other religions.
changed_reading.after: A released message of firm guidance is driven into visibility across the whole religious field, and its emergence does not depend on hostile consent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled din at words 6 and 10, haqq at word 7, and the opposition of the mushrikun at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two din occurrences can open an accounting and allegiance field: the due and true account is placed above every account, while those invested in shared authority resist an exclusive settlement of claims.

activation_trace.role: Debt and credit recast both din occurrences as a field of liabilities, claims, and entrusted return.
Reckoning and recompense make the same field consequential rather than merely classificatory.
A due obligation or deserved claim marks this din as what is owed and warranted.
Being over or overcoming gives the due order precedence across competing accounts.
Sharing and partnership make the opposition structurally about rival shares in authority and obligation.

changed_reading.before: The verse compares named religions and predicts the victory of one label.
changed_reading.after: It can also gather every debt, recompense, obligation, and allegiance under a uniquely due order contested by rival partnership claims.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Huda at word 5, the repeated din, the spatial verb at word 8, and mushrikun at word 14.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance defines intended direction among habitual routes; manifestation over all din can be spatialized as one legible outer route across branching tracks, while shirk names divided route-participation as well as doctrinal association.

activation_trace.role: Course, manner, and intended direction turn guidance into orientation through a route-system.
Habit and customary state make each din a repeatedly traveled social course.
The overland route and outer districts spatialize manifestation as emergence onto a traversable public way.
Main tracks and branching ruts supply the divided path-network through which the directed way must become legible.
Totality scopes the route image across every habitual course rather than one local track.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is abstract information set against abstract religions.
changed_reading.after: Guidance becomes orientation through a landscape of habitual and branching tracks, with the true course emerging as the public route across the whole network.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening cosmic merism makes total din more than a census of human confessions: moving praise between the upper and lower poles under precise ordering can be read as an already enacted submission that the messenger makes socially visible.

activation_trace.role: Obedience and submission anchor the cosmic-order proposal back in both focus occurrences of din.
Coming into view makes human manifestation the visible register of a wider order.
Running or swimming gives the opening praise kinetic participation in an ordered field.
What rises overhead supplies the upper pole of the universal merism.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the complementary pole and closes the spatial field.
Precision and tight ordering make the field a coordinated system rather than a loose collection.

structural_cues: 61:1 opens with the heavens-earth merism; 61:9 expands the purpose over din kullihi.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal praise, vertical poles, and precise order; I infer that human din can visibly register an alignment already spanning creation. Alternatively, kullihi may remain restricted to the human religious field.

changed_reading.before: All din is only the set of rival human institutions.
changed_reading.after: The messenger's mission can make human society visibly join a submission and order already enacted across the whole created field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated split between saying and doing changes manifestation from publicity alone into embodied correspondence: true din becomes visible when its utterance is carried by matching action rather than contradicted performance.

activation_trace.role: Coming into view remains the focus operation but now requires a trustworthy visible bearer.
Making truth stand supplies the integrity produced when declaration and action coincide.
A thing's saying as its indication makes conduct itself capable of speaking for the message.
Producing an act supplies the material test of what speech claims.
Severe aversion toward ugliness marks contradiction as an anti-manifestation that deforms the message's appearance.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeat the same saying-without-doing construction before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated verbal-action mismatch and severe aversion; I infer that matched action is a causal medium of izhar. Alternatively, the rebuke may regulate believers without specifying how the focus purpose is realized.

changed_reading.before: Making the din appear means maximizing its verbal announcement.
changed_reading.after: Its decisive visibility includes lives and collective acts that make the carried claim stand instead of publicly contradicting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Straight alignment, joined construction, and tight compaction activate the support sense of izhar: din becomes manifest as a coherent, load-bearing collective whose fitted parts give the true claim social standing.

activation_trace.role: Backing and support shift izhar from flat visibility toward sustained standing through a supporting body.
Tight-made firmness anchors the building analogy in the focus description of din as haqq.
Alignment on a straight line supplies coordinated placement of participants.
Joining part to part supplies the constructive relation that turns plurality into one structure.
Tight compaction supplies resistance to gaps and makes the structure capable of bearing force.

structural_cues: 61:4 compresses row, simile, building, and compaction into one collective image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned and tightly joined construction; I infer that such embodied coherence backs and displays din. Alternatively, the construction image may concern only one mode of struggle, not the whole mechanism of izhar.

changed_reading.before: Manifestation is an event that happens to an otherwise abstract doctrine.
changed_reading.after: Manifestation also takes structural form when aligned people become the fitted support through which the true order can stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance remains a directed offer, but deliberate deviation is followed by a reversal of the receptive center. The focus's universal outward scope therefore coexists with sharply non-universal inward reception.

activation_trace.role: Gentle direction anchors the supplied route whose reception is at issue.
Hard-headed resistance lets focus aversion develop into a directional refusal rather than a passing feeling.
Deviation from straightness supplies both the initiating turn and its causative intensification.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the reversal of the receptive center.
The denied gentle direction marks the consequence: the route remains real while access to it is not uniform.

structural_cues: 61:5 sequences their deviation, divine causation, heart-turning, and withheld guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit deviation-then-reversal sequence; I infer that the focus aversion can name the receptor-side beginning of that process. Alternatively, the opponents' aversion in 61:9 may be only an ineffective backdrop to public victory.

changed_reading.before: Dominance over all din implies that everyone will inwardly receive the guidance.
changed_reading.after: The guidance can become universally manifest while resistant recipients deviate further and lose the capacity to follow it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A messenger confirms what is before him and announces one after him; dispatch therefore unfolds as a relay of mutually attesting messages, making truth stand cumulatively through time rather than in one isolated arrival.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches makes the focus dispatch capable of belonging to a temporal relay.
The two messenger positions realize successive carriers within the same ayah.
Fulfilling promise and deed supplies backward attestation rather than mere chronological replacement.
After in contrast with before gives the relay a directional temporal axis.
Disclosure through speech or sign makes each stage evidentially legible to the next audience.

structural_cues: 61:6 places confirming what is before and announcing a messenger after within one speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies before-after sequencing, two messenger mentions, and confirmation; I infer that cumulative attestation is one temporal mechanism of izhar. Alternatively, 61:9 may concern only the final dispatched messenger's outcome.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a self-contained mission whose manifestation is instantaneous.
changed_reading.after: The mission is one relay-stage in a diachronic disclosure where messages confirm, announce, arrive, and cumulatively make the true order stand.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs can be called magic, fabricated claims can be placed on God, and a false garment can misreport its wearer. Mere appearance is therefore insufficient: izhar must include durable discrimination and standing through hostile relabeling.

activation_trace.role: Coming into view supplies the baseline that the context now tests for epistemic sufficiency.
Firm truth against falsehood requires the visible claim to survive counterfeit classification.
Appearance and disclosure supply signs that are genuinely clear before hostile naming intervenes.
Diversion and deception supply the hostile label that attempts to invert the signs' meaning.
Fabricated falsehood supplies a manufactured rival appearance laid upon God.
A garment that lies by its condition supplies the possibility of a surface that falsely signifies its bearer.
Calling and inclining by speech keeps the genuine invitation active inside the contest of labels.

structural_cues: 61:6 moves from clear signs to the label magic; 61:7 opposes fabricated attribution to an active call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear signs plus hostile and fabricated counter-labels; I infer that public visibility must become publicly discriminable, not merely spectacular. Alternatively, izhar may still denote dominance without resolving every observer's misdescription.

changed_reading.before: Once the message is visible, its truth is self-evident to every observer.
changed_reading.after: Manifestation is the true claim's ability to remain exposed, testable, and standing even when visible evidence is redescribed as magic or covered by fabricated signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oral suppression attempts to cool and cover a visible beacon, while divine completion carries that light to fullness. The focus purpose becomes an irreversible process of completed legibility, not only a single contest outcome.

activation_trace.role: Emergence into view is illuminated as the result that attempted extinguishing cannot cancel.
Cooling flame and stilling embers supply the attempted interruption of disclosure.
A conspicuous beacon gives manifestation a public orienting medium.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies hostile utterance as the instrument of attempted suppression.
Reaching completion supplies the counter-process that carries disclosure through interruption.
Covering supplies the opponents' contrary operation against exposed light.

structural_cues: 61:8 immediately precedes the focus and shares the wa-law kariha concession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinguishing, mouth-speech, beacon, covering, and completion; I infer that these form a suppression-completion mechanism fulfilled by izhar in 61:9. Alternatively, the light image and the din-over-din claim may be parallel promises rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus predicts a discrete victory imposed after opposition.
changed_reading.after: It completes the preceding image: attempted speech-covering cannot stop the sent guidance from becoming a full, public, orienting light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The due-order baseline becomes actionable when a sign points to a trade in which wealth and selves are committed through strenuous effort for rescue. Din al-haqq can thus organize a binding account with stakes, performance, and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Debt and credit anchor the transactional reading in the focus's doubled din.
Due obligation gives the proposed account a warranted claim rather than arbitrary exchange.
Indicating by a sign turns the following trade into an instructed route continuous with focus guidance.
Trade and seeking profit supply the explicit exchange frame.
Rescue by separation supplies the account's promised consequence.
Exerting capacity under hardship supplies costly performance rather than nominal assent.
Possessed wealth supplies one class of committed stake.
The thing or self itself supplies the non-substitutable personal stake.

structural_cues: 61:10 asks whether to indicate a saving trade; 61:11 answers with belief and costly action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sign, trade, stakes, effort, and rescue; I infer that they concretize the focus debt-and-due branches as a covenantal account. Alternatively, trade may remain a local metaphor for reward without reopening din semantically.

changed_reading.before: Din al-haqq is an abstract proposition that observers either accept or reject.
changed_reading.after: It is also a binding due-order entered through trust and costly performance, with wealth and self placed into an account whose promised return is rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes din visible, but the promised result covers sins protectively and admits people into tree-covered gardens. Manifestation therefore targets the truth and order, not indiscriminate exposure of persons; disclosure and merciful concealment operate together.

activation_trace.role: Coming into view supplies the public disclosure whose object must now be distinguished.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies personal concealment as a beneficial operation.
Entry into an interior supplies movement from public struggle toward protected habitation.
A garden covered by trees supplies the destination where sheltering concealment is fulfilled.

structural_cues: 61:12 orders forgiveness before entry into gardens and dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies focus disclosure beside protective covering and covered gardens; I infer a selective object distinction: din is exposed while forgiven persons are sheltered. Alternatively, concealment may be only subsequent reward with no bearing on the manner of izhar.

changed_reading.before: Manifestation means exposing everything and everyone to public view.
changed_reading.after: The true order is made public precisely so that persons can have faults covered and be brought into protected interior life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near aid and opening activate both support and overcoming in izhar. Preeminence arrives as a closed field becoming accessible through supplied help, while the victory sense remains live beside the opening sense.

activation_trace.role: Backing and support make manifestation dependent on enabling aid rather than unsupported expansion.
Being upper or overcoming preserves the competitive result alongside the enabling mechanism.
Aid that also makes manifest directly joins support to public ascendancy.
Opening what is closed supplies access and expansion as one mode of the promised outcome.
The opening of victory keeps conquest as a coexisting, not erased, branch of the same event.
Temporal nearness turns the outcome from remote abstraction into an approaching process.

structural_cues: 61:13 apposes help from God with a near opening after the promised trade and reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aid, opening, victory, and temporal nearness; I infer that these name enabling stages of focus izhar. Alternatively, they may promise a separate near event while 61:9 retains a broader horizon.

changed_reading.before: Preeminence is only coercive displacement of rivals.
changed_reading.after: It can be both victory and an aided opening of closed access, with support producing public reach while competition remains real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final call makes people helpers, divides the audience into two groups, supplies divine backing, and makes believers zahirin. The focus purpose is thereby realized through supported participants who themselves become visible and upper.

activation_trace.role: Backing and support in the focus verb anticipate a community that can carry and be carried by support.
Aid that makes manifest turns the repeated helper-call into participatory agency.
An encircling group supplies the two bounded collective responses through which reception divides.
Confirming strength supplies the divine backing that changes one group's position.
Being backed names the enabling condition realized in the believers.
Becoming upper or overcoming names their resulting relation to the opposing group.

structural_cues: 61:14 moves from the imperative to be helpers, through two groups, to divine support and the lexical echo zahirin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a helper-call, split groups, divine strengthening, and the exact z-h-r echo; I infer that supported people are a medium of din's manifestation while divine agency remains primary. Alternatively, the focus pronoun may refer directly to din or the message without identifying the community as its vehicle.

changed_reading.before: God makes an impersonal doctrine dominant while believers remain spectators.
changed_reading.after: Divine backing recruits helpers and makes a believing community itself visible and upper, so the order's manifestation and its bearers' transformed position occur together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant h-d-y to h-d-d split and must not replace huda with threat lexically. It remains anchored in focus word 5 and in the purpose of becoming upper over rival orders; downstream prose should render it only as the guidance's experienced pressure on entrenched systems.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Huda at word 5, izhar at word 8, and resistant aversion at word 13.

activation_trace.role: Threatening, from the non-dominant split inventory, supplies destabilizing pressure experienced by rival orders rather than a translation of huda.
Becoming upper gives that pressure a relational outcome in the competing field.
Hard-headed resistance explains why gentle guidance can be experienced as structural threat.

changed_reading.before: Guidance only attracts by gently indicating a route.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be guidance, its arrival can register to entrenched rival orders as a destabilizing threat to their upper position.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The gift and bridal-transfer images are cross-domain and should not be asserted as the lexical meaning of huda. They remain anchored in the focus's dispatch, due din, haqq, and partnership opposition; downstream prose should present a covenantal analogy in which gracious transfer also establishes a binding claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sent messenger with huda at words 3-5, din al-haqq at words 6-7, and partnership opposition at word 14.

activation_trace.role: Ease and willing giving let dispatch carry the affect of a freely bestowed benefit.
A gracious gift sent to someone close supplies relational generosity within the carried guidance.
A bride conducted into relation supplies the contained image of ceremonial transfer into covenant.
Debt and credit make the gracious transfer consequential as an entrusted relational account.
A due claim keeps gift from collapsing into consequence-free possession.
Affinal partnership supplies the rival relational claim that resists exclusive allegiance.

changed_reading.before: The mission is only command transmitted into a competitive public arena.
changed_reading.after: It can also be imaged as a graciously conducted gift that establishes a due covenantal relation, against rival partnership claims.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hunter's snare is a distant branch of shirk and should remain an analogy, not an accusation that every alternative path is literally a trap. It remains focus-anchored through guidance as direction, mushrikun, and izhar as finding out; downstream prose should qualify it as a possible diagnostic function of manifestation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Directed huda at word 5, finding or access in izhar at word 8, and mushrikun at word 14.

activation_trace.role: Intended direction supplies the traveler and route against which hidden capture can be diagnosed.
Finding out or gaining access makes manifestation an uncovering of route conditions.
The hunter's snare supplies a hidden capture mechanism within the opposition's divided route-network.

changed_reading.before: The opponents merely hold different beliefs and dislike losing status.
changed_reading.after: One exploratory function of manifest guidance is to make the hidden capture mechanisms of divided allegiances findable to travelers.

strongest_changes: Izhar moved from flat triumph to completed, testable visibility that must survive speech-action contradiction and counterfeit labeling.
Rows, joined construction, aid, and the final z-h-r echo made manifestation a supported collective condition as well as a claim about din.
The doubled din, due haqq, trade, wealth, and selves activated a coexisting account of obligation, stake, performance, and return.
Messenger succession made disclosure cumulative through confirmation, announcement, arrival, and later public standing.
Forgiveness and covered gardens distinguished making the true order public from exposing the persons brought under its protection.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly changed the operative sense of manifestation without forcing a single winner: visibility, structural backing, overcoming, opening, cosmic alignment, enacted congruence, accounting, and protected habitation remain mutually illuminating readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus pronoun in liyuzhirahu remains compatible with closely related carriers such as the messenger, guidance, message, or din; the branch trace does not settle the syntax by itself.
Visibility, backing, and overcoming are all strongly activated in z-h-r, and the final echo supports coexistence more than disambiguation.
The debt, gift, route, and snare models depend on controlled branch transfer and should remain analogical rather than lexical replacements.
The non-dominant h-d-d inventory is worth preserving only as a contained pressure image, never as a translation of huda.
